```{r}
library(jsonlite)
```


```{r}
df_activity <- data.table::fread("C:/Users/inapa/Documents/Repertoire etudiant_IMP/Projets/Projet 15 UMC cardio/stats_UMC cardio/SQLNM_2027/for_SWaPAM/combinations/model_inhouse_v9_data_GTEX_example_n10_tasklist_test_gtex_Eraslan2019V1_UniKPV1/reaction_activity_df.csv")

```

```{r}
RAS_per_sample_long <- df_activity %>%
  dplyr::rename('rxn_id' = 'V1') %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with('GTEX'), values_to = 'RAS', names_to = 'RNA_name')
```

load lists of transport and GPRless reactions
```{r}
list_exchange_rxns <- fromJSON("data/raw/list_exchange_reactions_model_v9.json")
list_GPRless_rxns <- fromJSON("data/raw/list_GPRless_model_v9.json")
list_transport_rxns <- fromJSON("data/raw/list_transport_rxns_model_v9.json")

list_GPRless_non_exchange_rxns <- list_GPRless_rxns[!list_GPRless_rxns %in% list_exchange_rxns]

list_GPRless_transport_rxns <- list_transport_rxns[list_transport_rxns %in% list_GPRless_non_exchange_rxns] # reactions that are transport and are GPRless
list_GPRless_non_transport_rxns <- list_GPRless_non_exchange_rxns[!list_GPRless_non_exchange_rxns %in% list_transport_rxns] # reactions that are GPRless and are not transport
```

these list are like MAR00001 but in the df_activity, some have _r or _f suffixes
so adding a _r and _f version of each reaction to catch all

```{r}
add_suffixes_to_list <- function(fun_list){c(fun_list, paste0(fun_list, '_f'), paste0(fun_list, '_r'))}

list_transport_rxns <- add_suffixes_to_list(list_transport_rxns)
list_GPRless_non_exchange_rxns <- add_suffixes_to_list(list_GPRless_non_exchange_rxns)
list_exchange_rxns <- add_suffixes_to_list(list_exchange_rxns)

list_GPRless_transport_rxns <- add_suffixes_to_list(list_GPRless_transport_rxns)
list_GPRless_non_transport_rxns <- add_suffixes_to_list(list_GPRless_non_transport_rxns)
```

verify
```{r}
RAS_per_sample_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(rxn_id %in% list_exchange_rxns) %>%
  dplyr::filter(RAS != -1)
# all exchange reactions are -1

RAS_per_sample_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(rxn_id %in% list_GPRless_transport_rxns) %>%
  group_by(RNA_name, RAS) %>%
  summarise(n_rxn = n_distinct(rxn_id), .groups = 'drop') 
# for GPRless transport rxns, all samples have only 1 value each (sample-specific)
 
RAS_per_sample_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(rxn_id %in% list_GPRless_non_transport_rxns) %>%
  group_by(RNA_name, RAS) %>%
  summarise(n_rxn = n_distinct(rxn_id), .groups = 'drop') 
# for GPRless non transport rxns, each sample has 2 values (this is because of the difference
# between Jelle's and I definition of transport rxn...) 
```

# calculate values to replace with
for median_RAS_non_transport, keep rxn that are:
- not exchange
- not transport
- not GPRless

for median_RAS_transport, keep rxn thare are:
- transport
- not GPRless
```{r}
median_RAS_non_transport <- RAS_per_sample_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(!rxn_id %in% list_exchange_rxns) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!rxn_id %in% list_transport_rxns) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!rxn_id %in% list_GPRless_non_exchange_rxns) %>%
  summarise(median = median(RAS)) %>%
  pull(median)

Q1_RAS_transport <- RAS_per_sample_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(rxn_id %in% list_transport_rxns) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!rxn_id %in% list_GPRless_non_exchange_rxns) %>%
  summarise(Q1 = quantile(RAS, probs = 0.25)) %>%
  pull(Q1)
```

# make replacements

```{r}
RAS_per_sample_long_imputed <- RAS_per_sample_long %>%
  mutate(RAS = case_when(rxn_id %in% list_GPRless_non_transport_rxns ~ median_RAS_non_transport,
                         rxn_id %in% list_GPRless_transport_rxns ~ Q1_RAS_transport,
                         TRUE ~ RAS))

RAS_per_sample_wide_imputed <- RAS_per_sample_long_imputed %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = 'RNA_name', values_from = 'RAS')
```

save
